spans.s:
m. (-भः)
Covetousness, cupidity, intense or greedy desire.
E.
लुभ to desire or covet, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Beguiled or overcome by cupidity.
E.
लोभ, and मोहित beguiled.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Free from cupidity.
E.
लोभ, and हिरह separate.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Tempted or attracted by greediness or desire.
E.
लोभ, and आकृष्ट drawn.

mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि)
Desirous, cupidinous, covetous, greedy.
E.
लोभ desire, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
Desirable.
m. (-म्यः)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.
लुभ to covet or desire, aff. ण्यत्.
